text.p: Typhoon Nestor, with 140 mph winds, is east of the Mariana Islands near 18n/148e, moving northwest at 9 mph. Nestor will turn more to the north northwest during the next 36 hours as top winds reach 160 mph. Nestor will be an extreme danger to shipping.

Tropical Depression 02E, with 35 mph winds, is centered 60 miles south southeast of Puerto Angel, Mexico, moving west northwest at 12 mph. T.D. 02E may reach tropical storm strength before making landfall in about 24 hours. A tropical storm warning is up from Puerto Angel to Acapulco. Heavy rain may lead to flash flooding and mudslides in the warned area, especially over the higher elevations.

A low pressure area moving through the eastern Gulf of Mexico, associated with the remains of Pacific T.D. Andres, will produce heavy rain over western Cuba during the next 24 hours, possibly resulting in flash flooding. Some of this heavy rain will also affect southern Florida and the Bahamas.
